Rental requirements

  • Valid two-wheeler driving licence (international permit for foreigners)
  • Government photo ID plus address proof
  • Refundable security deposit: ₹3,000–₹10,000
  • Minimum age 21. Helmet is compulsory.
  • No off-roading on city bikes. Return with the same fuel level.

Built by riders, for explorers

WyldMiles began when our founder, Aarav, quit his desk job and rode from Pune to Ladakh with one bag and a broken GPS. He came back with one idea: make wild trips easy and safe for everyone.

Mission: Make adventure open to all.
Safety promise: Trained guides, first-aid kits, insured bikes, live trip tracking.
